On 20 September 2026, attrition said four people had attended the '''19 September 2026 Utah meetup''' the night before, that thrice did not lose a game in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] or in the cube games, and that no pictures were taken.<ref name="utah">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1526611765947797727/1551248055863615653 attrition, Star Wars CCG Discord #utah-january-9th, 20 September 2026].</ref> The message does not call thrice the champion.
